task.title: Task Title
task.shortdesc: Resetting your Unity password may resolve problems accessing digital resources.

taskbody.prereq: If you are setting up your Unity account for the first time, see Setting Up Your Unity Account.
taskbody.context: If you are experiencing problems accessing websites, applications, or resources with your Unity username and password, you may need to perform a password reset to regain access to your account. There are two steps to resetting your password: resetting your password and setting a new password.

step.cmd: Enter your Unity ID (i.e., your Unity username) and select Submit.
Provide the answer to the security question and select Submit.
step.stepresult:
If you were able to answer your question correctly, your password will be reset to its default value. You will use this default value for the current password field on the password change form.
Your default password is an 8-digit number composed of the last 4 digits of your Campus ID number (your student or employee ID number), followed by your 2-digit birth month and 2-digit birth day.
You will have 30 minutes to use the default password to set a new password.
The default password will not allow you to sign in to any NC State services You must change your password from the default before you can log in.
step.steptroubleshooting: Contact the NC State Help Desk if you are having trouble.

note.p: You must create a new password; the system will not allow you to reuse old passwords. The password requirements must be met and there are strong password recommendations provided as well.

step.cmd: Enter your Unity ID (i.e., your Unity username) in the Unity ID field.
Enter your default password in the Current Password field.
Enter your new password in the New Password field.
Enter your new password again in the Confirm New Password field.

step.stepresult: You should receive a successful password change message in about a minute.

steptroubleshooting.p: If you receive an error message instead, make the necessary corrections to your new password and resubmit for the form.

note.p: In most cases, the new password will work almost immediately with MyPack Portal or other Shibboleth logins, but it can take up to an hour to synchronize across all systems. If your new password does not work for Gmail, please wait 10 minutes and try logging in again. If your password is still not working, please wait the full hour before trying to log in again.

tasktroubleshooting.p: If you need further assistance, encounter any error messages, or have trouble logging into your Unity account after changing your password, you can contact the NC State Help Desk or visit the OIT Walk-In Center.
